sources.label: MVS community weapon catalog
sources.usage: Primary exact-game community item list, type, rarity, and thumbnail source.

sources.label: MVS community values endpoint
sources.usage: Community trade value, demand, and trend fields. Not official Roblox data.

sources.label: Roblox games API - universe 7219654364
sources.usage: Exact game identity, creator, root place, and current metadata.

sources.label: Roblox game-passes API - universe 7219654364
sources.usage: Official pack/pass names and pack weapon descriptions.

sources.label: Roblox developer-products API - universe 7219654364
sources.usage: Official direct-purchase, box, event product, bundle, and Robux price leads.

sources.label: Roblox virtual-events API - universe 7219654364
sources.usage: Official event context and source caveats for event-origin weapons.

exclusions: 29 Effect rows from the MVS community weapon catalog are excluded and belong to the death-effects catalog.
Revolver Default is excluded because the MVS source marks it with specialLabel Staff.
Gamepasses, currency products, battlepass skips, boxes/crates, bundles, badges, servers, code rows, and wrong-universe data are not standalone weapon rows.
Sealord Revolver and Sealord Trident are not included because they were not present in the checked MVS weapon catalog; official event text alone needs parent review before adding durable rows.
notes: Values, demand, and trend are community-maintained fields from the MVS values endpoint and should be rendered with caveats.
Rows without direct official product/pass matches keep sourceConfidence medium until obtainment route is verified.
Shared route/config still needs parent integration before rendered card counts can be verified.
